runtime.name: omp
runtime.configuration: Generated Skill copied under project .agents/skills; includeSkills cleared and asynchronous jobs enabled by the follow-up probe overlay.
runtime.permissionProfile: Only read, task, and hub tools enabled; fixture required no writes

assertions.evidence: The root explicitly loaded the generated check-follow-up Skill.
One task invocation created the single FollowUpWorker identity.
FollowUpWorker returned SEED_MARKER=seed-ok before the second instruction was sent.
Native hub send targeted FollowUpWorker and returned a woken receipt rather than creating another worker.
The same FollowUpWorker identity returned the second result after it was woken.
The second result reported REMEMBERED_SEED_MARKER=seed-ok and stated that seed.txt was not read again.
FollowUpWorker read follow-up.txt on its second turn and returned FOLLOW_UP_MARKER=follow-up-ok.
The root re-read assets/root.txt after the second worker result and observed ROOT_MARKER=follow-up-root-ok.
Only read, task, and hub tools were enabled and the external post-run Git status was clean.

limitations: This fixture proves follow-up to a completed read-only worker and context retention on that worker, not cancellation, stale-result suppression, transcript access, or writer isolation.
OMP remains overall D0 because its separate plugin-manager dry-run probe failed the D1 safety gate.
